fact: On 15 July 2025 the Direção Nacional da Educação began national training of the EMAEI coordinators and the municipal SIGE focal points in a new SIGE module for assessing children with special educational needs; the National Director named UNICEF as the initiative's main funder and Devtrust as the company that developed the module.
title: Direção Nacional da Educação realiza ação formativa no novo módulo de crianças com Necessidades Educativas Especiais no SIGE
